(Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the studs are spaced at either approximately sixteen inches or approximately twenty-four inches on center.

(Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, and wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

(Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation, and causes the cooled air to flow through an opening.

(Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 11, wherein the housing includes a front cover that is secured to allow access to the components within the housing.

(Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, comprising: in a housing that is mountable within a structure wall, a cooling system for evaporatively cooling an indoor area. 

(Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 18, wherein the mounting includes placing the cooling system between wall studs spaced at either approximately sixteen inches or approximately twenty-four inches on center.
